items.title: A Noetherian space is quasi-compact, and so is every subset
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a Noetherian topological space is quasi-compact and that every subset of it is quasi-compact (author lemma at source lines 2148-2155, label lemma-Noetherian-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 2157-2169) argues by contradiction from an open covering with no finite refinement, producing a strictly decreasing sequence of closed subsets and contradicting the ascending chain condition, and reads the subset assertion off the inheritance of Noetherianity (proof lines 2157-2168). The inductive construction of the descending chain is the content. H3.
